inputs.quote: my existing two-column Czech word and meaning list

steps.action: Keep the WORD column visible and cover the MEANING column; say each Czech word's meaning aloud, then uncover to check and recover MEANING before the next word. If none are known, use the whole list.
steps.reason: Saying before checking forces recall, and recovering the answer column keeps every later attempt honest.

steps.action: Cover the MEANING column again and repeat the full list, prioritising words you missed; say each meaning, uncover to check, then recover MEANING.
steps.reason: A second hidden attempt strengthens weak items and confirms which meanings still need work.

steps.action: Cover the WORD column, keep MEANING visible, and write the Czech for each meaning on paper; uncover WORD to check spelling, then cover WORD again.
steps.reason: Writing from the meaning tests productive spelling, and re-covering the prompt column prevents copying on the next item.

steps.action: Read the correct spellings aloud against your written Czech, mark differences, then cover WORD and rewrite missed items from their meanings.
steps.reason: Comparing written attempts with the list exposes spelling gaps, and rewriting fixes them while recall is fresh.

AL09.question: The ready-made German picture cards have a plant image on the front and its German name on the back. Give me two picture-to-word spelling drills within 98 seconds total. For every card write the German name before you flip, then check it and put that same card back picture-side up before moving on.

value.answer:
1. Picture-to-word spelling drill — 49 seconds
- Shuffle the full plant-card deck picture-side up, then for each card write the German plant name on paper before flipping once to check it, and immediately return that same card picture-side up before moving to the next card, so every attempt is a written recall followed by a self-check and a reset; work through as many cards as fit in 49 seconds, and if the deck is empty or has fewer cards than you expect, just do the pass with whatever cards exist (or note there are none and skip to drill 2).

2. Picture-to-word spelling drill — 49 seconds
- Reshuffle the whole deck picture-side up, then repeat the same cycle — write the German name, flip once to check, return that card picture-side up — for as many cards as fit in 49 seconds, giving a second full written-recall pass over the same ready-made cards.
